entries.notes: Full source experiment, algorithm, generator and source-data substitutions checked. All 20 SHA256-bound shards, all 2000 unique seeds/trial kernel hashes/timings/histories and stated diagnostic thresholds checked; every mean, sample standard deviation, minimum and maximum recomputed. Four representative full-size trial reruns per study checked independently as specified below, not a claim that all 2000 terminal vectors were independently regenerated. Standard LP barrier: full n=2m sizes; initial centering excluded; exact t ratio 10000, with actual certified gap ratios correctly checked within approximate-centering tolerance. Mean counts at m=10/1000 are 18.84/25.23. Regenerated endpoint replicate 0 plus (m,replicate)=(144,7),(1000,53), independently recomputing primal/dual equations, strict positivity and objective gaps. Six full-sweep aggregate/regeneration tests passed. Actual tables and error-bar plot visually inspected. Aggregate execution envelope and per-trial execution evidence are distinct and both preserved.
